items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Most single videos are delivered within 5-7 days. Bundles and campaigns take 10-14 days depending on scope.

items.question: Do you offer revisions?
items.answer: Yes. Basic includes 1 revision, Standard 2, and Premium has unlimited revisions within the agreed scope.

items.question: What is your process?
items.answer: Brief → concept → filming → editing → delivery → revision (if needed). I keep you updated at every step.

items.question: Do you work in English and Spanish?
items.answer: Yes. I can create content in both languages, or voiceover in either.

items.question: Do you offer commercial use and whitelisting?
items.answer: Yes. Commercial use is included in Standard and Premium. Whitelisting is available in Premium or as an add-on.

items.question: How do I contact you?
